issue.title: Relation = alias, direction flips, and the == escape
issue.description: In Bob Mac Capture, `=` is the only relation alias for `~`, and it opens Links To only where Bob's gate allows. A `~` or `=` glued to a complete `~note:id` / `~~note:id` flips its direction. The relation label card flips direction with `~` / `=` and re-asks Bob for the new direction. A fast `==` types one literal `=` on every surface where `=` stands for `~`. Bob stays the only grammar authority, and `bob capture` / `capture-parse` stay literal.

issue.title: Mac relation label card flips direction
issue.description: card-flip: in the Mac relation label card, `~`/`=` flip the relation in choose mode, edit the token, re-fetch catalog and verdicts, and support a fast `==` literal escape. Also adds teaching keycaps and fixes Escape from a Shift-Return card. Mac only.

issue.title: Bob capture-rewrite relation grammar
issue.description: bob-grammar: in bob-cli capture-rewrite, an `=` opener replaces the relation `-` alias, `~~=` gives `~`, and a new `toggle_relation_direction` rule flips a complete token on a glued `~`/`=`. Ships with docs, help, and tests as `feat(capture)!`.

issue.title: Mac adopts the = opener and post-token flip
issue.description: mac-equals-opener: the Mac forwards `=` and token-glued `~` to Bob and replaces the dash arm with an equals opener arm that keeps the Space/Escape restores. It applies `toggle_relation_direction` natively without a picker and deletes every relation `-` path.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/relation_equals_alias_and_direction_flips.md defines phase mac-equals-opener as one work unit

issue.title: Fast == escape in the editor and picker
issue.description: equals-escape: one shared equals-gesture record with a ~350 ms key-to-key window, so a fast second `=` undoes whatever the first `=` did and types one `=`. Covers the editor before and after Bob replies, every flip, and the picker; the card reuses it.
